stress.description: Mental or emotional pressure, overload, strain, or excessive demands.

fear.description: Feeling afraid, frightened, scared, unsafe, or expecting harm.

anxiety.description: Persistent worry, nervousness, apprehension, uncertainty, panic, or excessive concern.

distress.description: Significant emotional suffering, helplessness, confusion, inability to cope, or feeling overwhelmed.

trauma.description: Psychological impact of a traumatic or deeply disturbing event, including recurring memories or nightmares.

threat.description: Threatening, intimidating, coercive, warning, harassment, or danger caused by another person or group.

violence.description: Physical violence, assault, beating, physical attack, or intentional physical harm.

immediate_danger.description: A person is currently or imminently in danger and may be harmed right now.

isolation.description: Being alone, socially isolated, disconnected, excluded, or lacking someone to talk to or support.

vulnerability.description: Reduced ability to protect oneself or cope because of displacement, homelessness, dependency, lack of support, financial hardship, or other vulnerability.
